entities.name: Església de Sant Pere del Tarter

entities.summary: Església de Sant Pere del Tarter is a church located in El Tarter, Canillo Parish, Andorra. It is a heritage property registered in the Cultural Heritage of Andorra. It was built in the 16th century.
